Prevention: Maintain proper plant spacing (45 x 30 cm)
Avoid excessive application of nitrogenous fertilizer
Monitoring: Observe for white powdery growth on upper surface
Observe for shedding of severely infected leaves
Apply direct control measures when disease first observed
Direct Control: Ampelomyces quisqualis @ 2% conc. at disease initiation stage
Restrictions: Use of personal protective equipment (PPEs) such as gloves, mask, goggles and keeping antidotes are mandatory by the spray applicators
Propineb @ 0.25% at disease initiation stage and repeat at weekly intervals.
